levels.name: Prophecy of Submersion
levels.description: When any of your own party members hits an opponent affected by an Omen, the effects of Hydro-related Elemental Reactions are enhanced for 8s: Electro-Charged DMG increases by 15%. Vaporize DMG increases by 15%. Hydro Swirl DMG increases by 15%. Frozen duration is extended by 15%.

levels.name: Lunar Chain
levels.description: When a Normal Attack hits, there is a 20% chance that it will be automatically followed by a Charged Attack. This effect can only occur once every 5s.

levels.name: Restless Revolution
levels.description: Increases the Level of Stellaris Phantasm by 3. Maximum upgrade level is 15.

levels.name: Prophecy of Oblivion
levels.description: When any party member attacks an opponent affected by an Omen, their CRIT Rate is increased by 15%.

levels.name: Mockery of Fortuna
levels.description: Increases the Level of Mirror Reflection of Doom by 3. Maximum upgrade level is 15.

levels.name: Rhetorics of Calamitas
levels.description: Upon entering Illusory Torrent, Mona gains a 60% increase to the DMG of her next Charged Attack per second of movemen A maximum DMG Bonus of 180% can be achieved in this manner. The effect lasts for no more than 8s.
